'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a mob drop, obtained by killing [[Monsters|orange slimes]], found only within the [[dungeon]]. Its primary use is to serve as an alchemical material, able to be broken down into reagents once studied, alongside [[onion]]s and [[red mushroom]]s.

==Alchemy==
{{PAGENAME}} can be decomposed to [[toxic solution|solution]] and [[toxic extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.

But orange slime only exists in [[dungeon]], and dungeon won't respawn mobs. So the amount of player can obtain in a round of game is limited. So, since it can only be used to craft basic [[alchemy]] resource, it is more recommended to craft it as a [[Toxic solution]] rather than a [[Toxic extract]] ([[Onion]] is a better source).<br>
